project_scope.note: B003 includes four strict target-zone PASS species plus O. lindheimeri as an explicit user-approved range exception. Former Gaura names are retained as synonyms.

shared_traits: capsule or indehiscent fruit useful diagnostically
priority: radial primrose flower versus former-Gaura flower architecture

study_strategy.warning: Do not rely on petal color alone. In this group, habit, floral symmetry/orientation, hairiness, hypanthium, and fruit are more diagnostic.
